title: Lucero: from the sidewalk to the table
goal: They come in, order from the table and come back another night.
audience: Neighbours choosing where to have dinner at night.

ig.name: The dish of the day
ig.msg: The dish of the day, served, with hands and steam, before 12 and before 19.
ig.rule: Stories for what changes and the feed for what stays; the menu link in the bio.
ig.watch: Taps on the menu link, one measure a month
ig.alt: Sample post with the dish of the day

board.name: The sidewalk board
board.msg: At the top the dish of the day, in the middle something that only happens today, at the bottom the QR.
board.rule: Big letters, white chalk, and a new board every day.
board.watch: Tables that arrive naming the board
board.alt: Sample sidewalk board with three lines

qr.name: The table QR
qr.msg: «Scan, order and Gus brings it», at eye level.
qr.rule: Printed matte and checked every week: one that came off is a table that stops ordering.
qr.watch: Loose QR codes in the weekly check

p.h: Scan, order and Gus brings it

qr.alt: Sample table stand with the QR and one line

carta.name: The menu on the phone
carta.msg: The table's menu on the phone, with the order going straight to the kitchen.
carta.rule: Every order reaches the kitchen with its origin: by QR or by the waiter.
carta.watch: Orders by QR and by the waiter
carta.alt: Sample menu on the phone with the Order button

ruleta.name: The house wheel
ruleta.msg: «Spin and win»: one spin per visit, as soon as the menu opens.
ruleta.rule: Prizes and odds are set in the CRM; each venue chooses its own.
ruleta.alt: Sample wheel with the prize House dessert

code.name: The code at the table
code.msg: «Show the code to the waiter»: the prize is validated in person.
code.rule: The waiter validates it at the table; one code per prize.

p.s: Show the code to the waiter

code.alt: Sample ticket with the prize code

review.name: The Google review
review.msg: Asked for with dessert or with the bill, once they have said they liked it.
review.rule: Reply to every one by name; to a bad one, thank them and continue in private.
review.alt: Sample review request with five stars to choose from

matches.name: The matchbox
matches.msg: A matchbox with the brand, to take home.
matches.rule: It comes with the bill: the submark on one side and the menu's QR on the other.
matches.watch: Visits that arrive from the box's QR

rules: One line per piece, in the voice of the bodegón.
What changes, in stories; what stays, in the feed.
The prize is validated in person, at the table.
next: The visit passport, already written in its roadmap.
source: The guides on Instagram, reviews, the QR and the board come from Eclipse Academy, in Lucero's repo; the matchbox is the playbook's proposal.
